settings.termsAndConditions:
1. Scope of Services: Beacon & Harbor provides administrative document review, procedural guidance, and application management services. We do not guarantee visa approval, as all adjudications are within the sole discretion of U.S. Consular authorities.
2. Manual Payment Policy: All application support service fees must be remitted via manual bank wire/transfer to the verified corporate accounts designated in the portal.
3. Confidentiality: All client records and uploaded travel credentials are encrypted and held in strict compliance with international privacy protocols.
settings.privacyPolicy: We collect applicant passport details, employment backgrounds, and financial proofs solely to evaluate visa eligibility and prepare compliant filings. Client documentation is retained under strict access controls and is never monetized or sold to third parties.
